title: My wall world changed once I found out my husband wanted a divorce.
content: I had been going to the same mall world over and over for about 2 years. It was always with bridges and water, everything was hard to get to or just off. I racked my brains as to what it could mean. An example would be going to a bridge and it was more like a car roller coaster. Everyone acted like it was normal, but I was alarmed. Anyway, in January he served me with divorce papers. My mall world disappeared. I spent a lot of time there. I’m just sharing because I think it was my subconscious trying to tell me something.
